purpose: Claim gate for separate atomic-physics branches inside the topic.

branches.allowed_usage_now: Accepted hydrogen-spectrum benchmark branch using the standard Rydberg relation with source-backed NIST/CODATA working copies.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Need a first-principles derivation before promoting beyond a benchmark branch.

branches.allowed_usage_now: Accepted atomic-constant consistency branch for `R_H` and related hydrogen residual checks.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Constant consistency does not independently validate atomic theory or UET derivation.

branches.allowed_usage_now: Accepted as an explicit inheritance map from standard atomic theory into the UET topic, with no first-principles UET derivation claim.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Need a UET-specific derivation artifact that derives alpha, R_H, and transition operators without treating inherited formulas as proof.

branches.allowed_usage_now: Selected rounded hydrogen n-level energies may be cited as a source-referenced benchmark when the artifact gate passes.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Need direct ASD per-level transcription precision, uncertainty propagation, and fine-structure/Lamb-shift separation before precision level claims.

branches.allowed_usage_now: Selected He+ and Li2+ one-electron ion rows may be cited as a provisional reduced-mass hydrogenic benchmark when the artifact gate passes.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Need direct primary ASD capture for Li III, source precision normalization, fine-structure component policy, and more ions before claiming general hydrogen-like ion validation.

branches.allowed_usage_now: May cite only as a prepared precision-source package for future fine/Lamb/hyperfine artifacts.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Need Dirac/QED/recoil/proton-radius/hyperfine model, uncertainty propagation, and residual thresholds before precision claims.

branches.allowed_usage_now: May cite only as a prepared neutral-helium source package plus diagnostic quantum-defect residual/prediction gates for future many-electron artifacts.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Need independent external holdouts, a correlated two-electron Hamiltonian/spectral model, uncertainty policy, and residual thresholds before helium or many-electron claims.

branches.allowed_usage_now: May cite only as a limited source-calibrated He I quantum-defect diagnostic with same-source-family holdouts.
branches.blocker_to_stronger_claim: Need independent external holdout lines and a CI/correlated model that predicts quantum defects instead of fitting them.
Need derivation and validation beyond the standard hydrogen Rydberg benchmark.

claim_boundary: This gate keeps the topic at hydrogen benchmark status, not full atomic-theory closure.
